description: This file defines a React functional component named PiiConfiguration, which provides a UI for selecting and configuring Personally Identifiable Information (PII) entities and actions, used within guardrail forms for data privacy management.

methods.name: PiiConfiguration
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a UI for configuring PII entity protections, allowing category filtering, select all/unselect all actions, and displaying the list of entities with selected actions.
